text:
alex: Heads-up — after yesterday's kernel rollout, we're seeing higher p95 on streaming chat when mb_size=8 even though throughput improves for non-streaming completions. Anyone else?

maria: saw it. p95 up ~40-60ms on tail for streaming, p99 up ~120ms. Non-streaming latency stable or slightly better. :thinking:

sam: quick question — are we still using kernel A for attention and kernel B fallback for long KV cache? Could be extra kernel switch cost per token for streaming.

jess: confirm: kernel selection logic did change to prefer fused-kv for batch>=4. That helps bulk but might add per-token overhead for streaming stream-chunking.

alex: exactly. hypothesis: streaming causes more frequent small KV ops and kernel launch overhead accumulates. Also KV cache miss path serializes some work.

maria: added profiling traces here: https://perf.internal/runs/1860001234

sam: snippet from perf trace:
```
ATTENTION_KERNEL: fused_kv (launchs: 2400)
KV_CACHE: hits 98.7% but avg access latency 0.9ms
kernel-switch overhead ~0.6ms per token
streaming chunk size 16 tokens
```

jess: that kernel-switch per-token is killer for p95. For non-streaming completions we amortize across longer outputs so it's fine.

infra-bot: deploy event: kernel-selector v2 rolled at 1860001200 by deploy-bot

alex: proposed experiment matrix:
- streaming: try mb_size 2,4 and enable stream-fast-path (no kernel switch)
- non-streaming: mb_size 8,16
- instrument tail-sampler and collect p50/p95/p99 + token-level kernel counts
Please run on canary pool.

sam: will run. config to use for streaming canary:
```
mb_size: 4
stream_fast_path: true
kernel_pref: streaming-fused
batching.window_ms: 15
```

jess: if stream_fast_path disables fused-kv, we must ensure memory usage ok. Add a coarse check to fail if native-kv usage > 90%.

maria: also let's add a microbenchmark: 100k streaming single-turn reqs with varied seq-lens to measure tail.

sam: started runs on canary; job id perf-canary-1860001250

alex: thanks. tagging @maria @jess — please check console traces and set alert if p95 > 250ms

maria: set alert.

sam: preliminary numbers from canary (mb=4, fast_path=true): streaming p95 down 45ms vs previous, throughput -10%. Non-streaming (mb=16) throughput +18%, latency stable.

jess: sounds promising. can we try heuristic: auto-select mb_size based on request.is_streaming ?

alex: yes — make batching heuristics streaming-aware: prefer smaller mb and shorter window_ms.

maria: I'll file a lightweight RFC for the heuristic change and include rollback plan.

alex: perfect. Follow-ups: add kernel-switch counters to per-request traces, and run 24h canary. If stable, promote.

sam: noted. I'll paste full perf CSV when complete.

alex: thanks team :thumbsup:
